0022600029.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (6-2) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-2) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game. The Thunder, 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West, have won their last two games and are 4-0 at home and 2-2 on the road, while the Grizzlies, 3rd in the Southwest and 5th in the West, have lost their last two and are 4-0 on the road. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams, Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber, and Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. while Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 3-0, including a 117-116 win in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
